subject.kind: a Claude Code skill: SKILL.md, playbooks, scripts and a page template
subject.purpose: grade any target into an HTML report card: find its subject, derive a rubric, grade it with evidence, show the page (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1046)
subject.reader: the owner, who reads the report card, and the agents that run the skill; a wrong or unreadable card sends the owner to fix the wrong thing
frameworks: research on rubric grading and report design, cited in references/report.md

folder-named-card.evidence: Command: ls skills -> card tree zoom; SKILL.md:2 'name: card'; no rubric folder
folder-named-card.why: Name matches and no rubric folder exists.

step-profile-subject.evidence: '1. **Subject**: read the target and write its kind, purpose and reader, each with a quote or path'
step-profile-subject.why: Step writes kind, purpose and reader.

step-derive-rubric.evidence: '2. **Rubric**: ... drawing criteria from the frameworks and the target's own stated purpose... The subject fills task.world and evidence_goal'

step-grade-target.evidence: '4. **Grade**: delegate the grading to fresh subagents... Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict'
step-grade-target.why: A Grade step gives a verdict per criterion.

output-html-report.evidence: '5. **Report**: run make-report.py <spec> <grades> <out>.html, then open it or publish it'
output-html-report.why: Final step names the HTML file.

report-built-like-peers.evidence: scripts/make-report.py, assets/report.html template, examples/*/report.html found by find
report-built-like-peers.why: Script, template and finished samples are all in the folder.

stops-at-rubric.evidence: Searched for a skill that ends at the rubric; report.md has steps 4 Grade and 5 Report after Rubric.
stops-at-rubric.why: Grade and Report steps exist, so the error is not committed.

verdict-fix-first.evidence: '**Verdict first, fixes next**: the page leads with the verdict and the fix list, highest tier first'
verdict-fix-first.why: Spec puts verdict and fixes first.

blended-number-first.evidence: report.md:41 'never with one blended number'; make-report.py headline is verdict_sentence naming the failing tier.
blended-number-first.why: Layout does not lead with a blended score.

evidence-before-verdict.evidence: 'Each quotes the evidence first, then gives the verdict; a verdict with no quote is not met.'

no-quote-not-met.evidence: Command: grep -n 'empty\|where' lib/rubric/grades.py -> line 42 rejects empty evidence; line 44 'met with no where... a verdict with no quote is not met'
no-quote-not-met.why: make-report.py refuses such grades, so a quoteless met verdict is not accepted.

judge-is-fresh.evidence: 'delegate the grading to fresh subagents, never the context that wrote or revised the target, giving each only the target, the spec and the grades grammar'
judge-is-fresh.why: Judge is fresh and gets only target and spec.

rubric-frozen.evidence: 'Freeze: take the spec's sha... before any grading... A change after grading makes a new version: save it under a new name'
rubric-frozen.why: Spec frozen by sha before grading; changes make new version.

failed-card-fields.evidence: card() in make-report.py prints criterion text, Evidence blockquote, why, and 'Fix:'; report.md:42 'each failure carries its evidence, its reason and a fix'

status-not-colour-alone.evidence: status_word returns '✓ Met', '✗ Not met', '? Not judged'
status-not-colour-alone.why: Each status has icon and word.

not-judged-section.evidence:
body(): out.append('

Not judged

... These could not be checked, each for the reason on its card. They are left out of the counts above'
not-judged-section.why: Separate section with reason, excluded from displayed counts.

description-use-when.why: Starts with Use when and under 300 chars.

routes-to-references.evidence: Route table rows: ask | playbook, e.g. '| grade a target and show the result... | references/report.md |'
routes-to-references.why: Table sends each case to a references file.

code-computes-in-scripts.evidence: scripts/make-report.py, score-spec.py, measure-judge.py; SKILL.md:34 'Scripts compute... never from your own arithmetic'
code-computes-in-scripts.why: Counting, scoring and page building are in verb-noun scripts.

no-agents-or-tests-dirs.evidence: Command: find card -type d ( -name agents -o -name tests -o -name evals ) | wc -l -> 0

body-short-flat.evidence: Command: wc -l SKILL.md -> 37; grep count of each references/*.md path in SKILL.md -> 1 for all 8
body-short-flat.why: Short and all references linked from SKILL.md.
